description_en: Switches the data synchronization link from a the primary ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance to a disaster recovery (DR) instance
description_zh: 该接口用于将RDS SQL Server主实例的复制链路切换到灾备实例
name: SwitchReplicationLink

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source or primary instance
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the destination DR instance
parameters.help_zh: 切换的目标灾备实例名称
parameters.name: target_instance_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region in which the destination DR instance resides
parameters.help_zh: 切换的目标灾备实例地域
parameters.name: target_instance_region_id
